name: 동공 불안 지수 분석
description: Measures pupillary unrest (hippus) — natural pupil oscillations absent in AI-generated faces.
mechanism:
This method analyzes pupillary unrest (hippus) for deepfake detection:

1. **동공Size측정**: Pupil diameter is measured per frame using iris-pupil boundary detection and ellipse fitting. High-resolution tracking captures the temporal signal of pupil diameter changes.

2. **Hippus감지**: Pupillary unrest (hippus) is the continuous, involuntary oscillation of pupil diameter at frequencies of 0.5-2 Hz with amplitude of 0.2-0.5mm. This is a normal physiological phenomenon reflecting sympathetic-parasympathetic nervous system interplay. The method checks for the presence and characteristics of hippus.

3. **Pupillary빛Reflex**: When illumination changes, pupils should constrict (light increase) or dilate (light decrease) with characteristic latency (~200ms) and dynamics (rapid constriction, slower dilation). The method checks for correct pupillary light reflex dynamics. Deepfakes typically don't model this physiological response.

4. **Bilateral동공Coordination**: Both pupils should show consensual response — constricting/dilating together with minimal difference (≤0.5mm). The method checks bilateral pupil size correlation. AI generators may produce independent pupil sizes between left and right eyes, violating the consensual pupil response.

5. **Cognitive동공Response**: Cognitive effort and emotional arousal produce small pupil dilations (0.1-0.5mm above baseline). The method analyzes whether pupil size correlates with speech content complexity and emotional context. Deepfake pupils that don't respond to cognitive demands lack this natural physiological signal.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
